---
title: "Bias Parameter"
subtitle: "Dynamically adjust queried values by adding a Param value."
format: html
engine: knitr
---

Recreates [Bias Parameter](https://idl.uw.edu/mosaic/examples/bias.html)
from the mosaic/vgplot example gallery. The SQL expression is
re-computed in the database upon updates.

```{r setup}
library(vgplotr)
```

```{r}
point <- param(point)

spec <-
  vg_create() |>
  vg_meta(
    title = "Bias Parameter",
    description = paste(
      "Dynamically adjust queried values by adding a Param value. The SQL expression is",
      "re-computed in the database upon updates."
    )
  ) |>
  vg_data(name = "walk", file = vg_example_url("random-walk.parquet")) |>
  vg_params(point = 0) |>
  vg_vconcat(
    vg_slider(label = "Bias", as = point, min = 0, max = 1000, step = 1),
    vg_mark_area_y(data_from = "walk", x = ~t, y = ~ sql("v + ", point), fill = "steelblue") |>
      vg_plot(width = 680, height = 200)
  )

vg_render(spec)
```

<details>
<summary>Comparing to mosaic's own JSON spec</summary>

```{r}
cat(to_json(spec))
```

Matches [mosaic's own JSON
spec](https://idl.uw.edu/mosaic/examples/bias.html) exactly, aside from
`data.walk.file` (`vg_example_url()` vs. a relative path) and object key
order.
</details>
